title: Terbium Triangle Bridged by a Triazole Nitronyl Nitroxide Radical with Single-Molecule-Magnet Behavior

material_class.structural_family: cyclic Tb3 triangle bridged by μ2-OH and 4-Me-3-NITtrz

synthesis.procedure: A solution of Tb(hfac)3·2H2O (80 mg, 0.1 mmol) in dry n-heptane (30 mL) was refluxed for 3 h, cooled to 60 °C, and treated with 4-Me-3-NITtrz (48 mg, 0.2 mmol) in CH2Cl2 (5 mL). The mixture was refluxed for 15 min, then Cu(hfac)3·2.5H2O (42 mg, 0.1 mmol; the main text names Cu(hfac)2·2H2O without an amount) was added. The green solution was refluxed for another 30 min at 60 °C, cooled to room temperature, filtered, and stored at 0–4 °C for two weeks to give blue-violet crystals. n-Heptane and dichloromethane had been distilled after drying over Na and CaH2, respectively. Tb(hfac)3·2H2O and 4-Me-3-NITtrz were prepared by literature methods.
synthesis.time: 3 h reflux of Tb precursor; 15 min after ligand addition; 30 min after Cu addition; 2 weeks crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux in n-heptane/CH2Cl2 followed by refrigeration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature, filtered, and stored at 0–4 °C for two weeks to afford blue-violet X-ray-quality crystals

properties.summary: Homometallic Tb3–radical cluster with ferromagnetic interactions at low temperature, magnetic anisotropy, a very narrow M–H hysteresis, dual slow relaxation under zero dc field (QTM-dominated), and a single field-induced Orbach process with Ueff = 14 K.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature; three Tb(III) plus two radicals; theoretical 36.14 cm^3 K mol^-1

measurements.name: effective energy barrier Ueff
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit under optimized Hdc = 2 kOe (2000 Oe); ac oscillation 3.5 Oe

measurements.name: Cole–Cole α
measurements.conditions: Hdc = 2 kOe, 2–3.2 K, generalized Debye model
